whatHappened: A file that no manifest admits appeared inside an owner-admitted output directory. It is a GDAL PAM sidecar holding a 256-bucket histogram of recorded-harvest-1985-2022.tif. GDAL writes one beside any raster whose statistics or histogram are computed, unless GDAL_PAM_ENABLED=NO is set, so reading the raster is what wrote it.

attribution.by: this engineering session, as an undirected diagnostic
attribution.basis: The command appears in this session's own transcript, and the sidecar's modification time matches. No repository script runs gdalinfo with -hist or -stats; scripts/check-raster-grid.mjs exists precisely to assert that -stats was never run against the grid record.
attribution.confidence: attributed, not merely assumed: the command and the timestamp agree, and it is the only such file that has ever existed anywhere under the archive.

detectedBy: check:phase2-historical-national-execution, whose readback asserts the exact contents of the admitted directory

admittedOutputs.method: SHA-256 and byte length of every listed output, read in full
admittedOutputs.note: The raster itself was last modified 2026-08-21T18:11 local, before the sidecar appeared. Nothing admitted was rewritten; a sibling file was added.

quarantined.reasonNotDeleted: The archive is the only project-data copy, and the doctrine is non-destructive. The file is preserved where a reader can still find it, rather than removed to make a gate green.

guard.covers: raw, extracted, derived and evidence, refusing any GDAL PAM sidecar, overview, external mask, or macOS Finder artifact
guard.priorCoverage: scripts/check-raster-grid.mjs guarded one record against gdalinfo -stats. Nothing guarded the archive.
